title: Watch the moment Jude Bellingham launches X-rated outburst at linesman during Real Madrid's derby draw with Atletico Madrid
text:
Jude Bellingham expressed his frustration with a line player during Madrid Derby Bellingham was angry with a decision made in the early stages of the game Listen now: Everything is starting! Does Premier League really need to look at goal celebrations? By Jeorge Bird
Published: 13:57 GMT, February 9, 2025 | Updated: 13:57 GMT, February 9, 2025
The Real Madrid star, Jude Bellingham, threw himself into a burst with X classification in a man of lines during the 1-1 draw of his team at home for the rivals Atlético de Madrid on Saturday.
It was a tense game between two of the title contestants, with a real point ahead of Atlético at the top of the table.
Bellingham’s frustration to boil after an incident in the 12th minute.
After Bellingham became possession with Marcos Llorente, the line player scored for Atlético.
That decision enraged Bellingham, who shouted: ‘Jode, man! F ** k off! In the official before shaking his head and fleeing.
Atlético took the lead in the 35th minute through a penalty by Julian Álvarez, but realized courtesy of Kylian Mbappe five minutes in the second half.

The midfielder was livid with the decision of a line player during the 1-1 draw with Atlético de Madrid
The true boss Carlo Ancelotti was not happy with the penalty granted to Atlético in the first half.
The stains kick occurred after a union between Aurelien Tchouameni and Samuel Lino in the area.
Although the referee César Soto grade lost the incident, he received instructions to consult VAR and subsequently gave a penalty.
Ancelotti said: ‘I don’t want to talk (about the referee). The penalty has been granted by VAR. The referee was very close and saw it well. I saw another penalty in the athletics of Girona … The people of football do not understand this.
‘I don’t want to go into a controversy that is quite large. It was a uniform and competitive party. As I said, we left the game with a draw, but we encourage. The team was good in the second half.
Real had suffered a 1-0 defeat to Espanyol in his previous game of LaLiga and now he must direct his attention to the Champions League.
The Ancelotti team travels to Manchester City on Tuesday for the first leg of its intriguing draw at the Play-Off.
Bellingham has had a significant impact since he joined Real Madrid in Borussia Dortmund in 2023.

In total, Bellingham has made 74 appearances actually, while he has scored 33 goals and provided 23 assists.
After winning the Champions League and LaLiga last season, Bellingham will be determined to raise this campaign more covered.
